_comment: CLI engine profiles. Switch with `engines use <name>`. The active engine controls SUSHI_CLI for new runs.

copilot.label: GitHub Copilot CLI
copilot.pitch: Good default if you already have Copilot access.

claude.label: Claude CLI
claude.pitch: Great reasoning, but often expensive; switch away when the budget gets noisy.

gemini.label: Gemini CLI
gemini.pitch: Useful alternate engine when you want a different model family.

agy.label: Antigravity / Agy
agy.pitch: IDE-style agent workflow with shared Sushi company state.

opencode.label: OpenCode
opencode.pitch: Open-source-oriented CLI option for teams avoiding premium lock-in.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.pitch: Editor-first workflow while keeping Sushi's agents and tickets portable.

windsurf.label: Windsurf
windsurf.pitch: Another editor/agent option for comparing quality and cost.

codex.label: OpenAI Codex CLI
codex.pitch: OpenAI's terminal coding agent; good fit when you want a GPT/Codex-native workflow.

aider.label: Aider
aider.pitch: Popular terminal pair-programmer with strong git-aware editing and low lock-in.

continue.label: Continue
continue.pitch: Open-source IDE and CLI assistant for teams that want portable model/config choices.

goose.label: Goose
goose.pitch: Open-source local agent with YAML config, extensions, permissions, and prompts.

cline.label: Cline
cline.pitch: Popular editor/terminal agent with project rules and memory-bank workflows.

junie.label: JetBrains Junie
junie.pitch: JetBrains-native agent option for developers living in IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, and friends.

zed.label: Zed AI
zed.pitch: Fast editor workflow with global AGENTS.md rules and project-level AI rule files.

tabby.label: Tabby
tabby.pitch: Self-hosted coding assistant option for teams that want local/control-first infrastructure.

kilo.label: Kilo Code
kilo.pitch: Open-source IDE/CLI coding assistant with project rules and configurable permissions.
